details:
Title: Can't favorite worlds anymore
Description:
When attempting to favorite a world, the button to do so is greyed out. This occurs even without reaching the favorite limit, nor does removing any worlds from favorites cause the button to become un-stuck.
Logging out and In, as well as Restarting VRChat, did not fix this issue.
An image is attached showing this bug. This world was previously favorited;  I un-favorited it while attempting to fix the button. I cannot favorite it again.
Repro Steps: Try to favorite any world.
Expected: The option to favorite is available, and works.
Actual: The option to favorite is unavailable, and does not work.
title: Cannot Favorite Worlds - Button Is Greyed Out
